findings.evidence: Never interpolate task text directly into shell syntax. Use a safely quoted argument or stdin to avoid command expansion.
findings.fix: Trim the generic shell-quoting lesson to the Codex-specific instruction (pipe the follow-up prompt to codex exec via stdin) and drop the general quoting advice the model already applies

findings.evidence: If absent or unsupported, stop and report; do not guess flags.
findings.fix: Define the support check (e.g., treat the CLI as unsupported only when 'codex exec --help' lacks the documented subcommands) or drop 'unsupported' and branch only on absence

findings.evidence: Resolve task intent, model (default `gpt-5.2`), and effort
findings.fix: Add a gotcha that default model names drift across CLI releases and may not exist on the installed version; verify the model name against the installed CLI before passing it

findings.evidence: Eval ids are read-only-review, requested-edit and resume-session; no failure-path case (CLI absent, non-zero exit, --last selecting the wrong session)
findings.fix: Add a fourth eval for the failure path asserting the skill reports actual diagnostics and stops without silent retry

findings.evidence: Use the narrowest supported network/workspace configuration.
findings.fix: Name the network-capable sandbox flag(s) for the pinned CLI version, or make preflight step 2 (inspect 'codex exec --help') mandatory before choosing any network configuration
